rules.title: Application Screening Fee Cap
rules.requirement: Landlords can charge an application screening fee to cover the cost of checking an applicant's background and credit, but the fee cannot exceed $30 per applicant (adjusted annually for inflation), must reflect actual costs, and must be refunded or applied under specific conditions if the applicant isn't considered or selected.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to any landlord or agent who charges an application screening fee to a prospective residential tenant in California.
rules.quoted_span: In no case shall the amount of the application screening fee charged by the landlord or their agent be greater than thirty dollars ($30) per applicant. The thirty dollar ($30) application screening fee may be adjusted annually by the landlord or their agent commensurate with an increase in the Consumer Price Index, beginning on January 1, 1998.
